title: Antarctic Ice Marathon — 2026 provisional schedule and prices
claims: The 2026 provisional schedule is: 9 December latest arrival at Punta Arenas; 10 December pre-departure briefings; 11 December Punta Arenas; 12 December flight to Union Glacier; 13 December Antarctic Ice Marathon / Half Marathon; 14 December return flight to Punta Arenas; 15 December departure.
All flights are subject to weather, aircraft serviceability and local conditions, and the schedule may shift.

The 2026 entry fee is USD 22,500, including race entry, briefing, round-trip flights from Punta Arenas to Antarctica, airport transfers for the Antarctic flight, meals and tented accommodation in Antarctica, a 25 kg baggage allowance and race souvenirs.
The payment schedule is USD 7,500 at registration, USD 7,500 by 1 December 2025 and the remaining USD 7,500 by 1 June 2026; later entries pay the full USD 22,500 if places remain.
